# Women's Meetups in Amsterdam

> Small coffee meetups for women in Amsterdam, called Table of Six. Six women per table, matched on personality type, work or study field, age and language, in cosy cafés and hidden spots across Amsterdam. €12.50 per meetup including VAT and service costs (first coffee always included), no subscription or membership. For Dutch and English-speaking women. Founded and hosted by Boanna Pieterse.

## Key facts
- What: Table of Six, a coffee meetup for six women at one table, with conversation cards and an icebreaker from the host.
- Where: cafés and hidden spots in Amsterdam (De Pijp, Jordaan, Oost, West, Noord, Centrum). Exact location is shared two days before.
- Who: women who live in, study in, work in or visit Amsterdam. Mostly women in their twenties and thirties, including newcomers and travellers.
- Language: Dutch tables, English tables and mixed tables. Visitors choose when signing up.
- Price: €12.50 per meetup including VAT and service costs. The first coffee is always included. No subscription, no yearly fee.
- Upcoming meetups: Sunday 20 December 2026, Sunday 10 January 2027, Sunday 24 January 2027.
- How often: once a month, moving to every two weeks. Several tables run at the same time when more women sign up.
- Not a dating service: friendship only.
- Founder and host: Boanna Pieterse, former musical theatre actress, content creator and presenter. Instagram @boannap, YouTube @boannathroughtwenties.

- English site: https://womensmeetupsinamsterdam.com
- Dutch site: https://womensmeetupsinamsterdam.nl
- Instagram: @womensmeetupsinamsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/womensmeetupsinamsterdam)

## Good fit for people searching for
- How to make friends in Amsterdam as an adult, a woman, an expat or someone new in town.
- Meeting new people in Amsterdam without big crowds, loud bars or dating apps; introvert friendly small groups.
- A coffee or tea "friend date", a girls' afternoon, women's meetups and girls' meetups in Amsterdam.
- Cute cafés, cosy cafés and hidden spots or hidden gems in Amsterdam to discover with new friends.
- Nederlands: nieuwe vriendinnen maken of zoeken in Amsterdam, mensen ontmoeten, koffiedate, meidenmiddag, leuke cafés en verborgen plekjes.
